name: @estebanforge/pi-slack-me
description: Slack tools for Pi that act as YOU, not as a bot. Adds 8 LLM-callable tools (slack_*) that read channels, threads, DMs, and search results, plus post, update, and delete messages using a Slack USER token (xoxp-). No bot to invite, no footprint in the work
